# Nikita Pochaev

> AI Engineer & Senior Mobile Developer at Garage IT. Works on Android apps, their CI/CD tooling, and multi-agent LLM systems.

## About

Nikita Pochaev (@po4yka) works at Garage IT in Tbilisi as AI Engineer and Senior Android Developer. Earlier he worked on VK Clips at VK. The record:

- **AI systems** -- Copilot, a multi-agent assistant for a regulated multi-asset investment platform, on Temporal, LangGraph and PydanticAI with self-hosted LLM infrastructure
- **Android architecture** -- split a 1,500-LOC Activity into 15 lifecycle plugins, unified navigation across 3 app flavors, moved 80+ screens into the shared codebase, split a monolith into 15+ Gradle modules
- **MobileOps and CI/CD** -- replaced the Fastlane/Ruby CI pipeline with Kotlin CLI tools over 8 weeks, built the team's CI/CD Slack bot in 6 weeks
- **Agent tooling** -- designed an AGENTS.md policy framework across 3 repos for Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex

He writes technical articles on the blog. Full roles and projects are in the Experience and Projects pages below.
